privateBuild: dotnet build tests/FakeGitHub -c Release -nodeReuse:false -p:UseSharedCompilation=false && dotnet build gateway -c Release -nodeReuse:false -p:UseSharedCompilation=false
unitTests: dotnet test of every test project under tests/ that is a .csproj (none before stage C task C0)
acceptanceGate: Tier 1 and the smoke test run in the pull request's CI (tests.yml); verified through the check-runs API. Subagents cannot run pwsh in their worktrees, and Tier 1 allows one run per machine.
preCommitReview: a reviewer subagent reviews the staged change before every commit
